simple.meaning: שִׁבֹּל (shibbôl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 41:5. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁבֹּל (H7641) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שִׁבֹּל (shibbôl) / H7641 is traced through Genesis 41:5, Genesis 41:6, Genesis 41:7, Genesis 41:22 with generated occurrence evidence.

Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.”

I am weary with my crying.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good.

definitions.short: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch
definitions.usage: branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare 5451 .
definitions.full: H7641. shibbol or shibboleth I. שִׁבֹּ֫לֶת noun feminine flowing stream ; — ׳שׁ absolute Psa 69:3 , as test of dialect Judg 12:6 (compare סִבֹּלֶת and GFM); construct ׳שׁ מַיִם Psa 69:16 , ׳שׁ הַנָּהָר Isa 27:12 . II. שִׁבֹּ֫לֶת noun feminine ear of grain ; — ׳שׁ absolute Job 24:21 +; plural שִׁבֳּלִים Gen 41:5 +, construct שִׁבֳּלֵי Zech 4:12 ; — ear , Gen 41:5-6 , 7: 41:7 ; 41:22 ; 41:23 ; 41:24 (twice in verse); 41:26-27 , Isa 17:5 (twice in verse); Ruth 2:2 ; Job 24:24 ; transf. spike (Pusey), end of olive bough Zech 4:12 .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת ; from the same as 7640 ;
